feed.title: AI Automation & Software Development Specialist (Code, Apps, AI Videos & Social Media Automation)
feed.description:
What We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions.

We are looking for someone who can:
Recommend better solutions
Build scalable automation systems
Integrate modern AI platforms
Improve development speed
Reduce manual work across our business

We want someone who stays current with the latest AI technologies and can explain why one solution is better than another.

Responsibilities
We are seeking proposals for automating and developing:
Software Development
AI-assisted code generation
Full-stack web application development
Mobile application development
Internal business software
API integrations
Database architecture
Workflow automation
AI agents
Backend automation
Custom dashboards
AI Video Creation

Automate:
Marketing videos
Product videos
Educational videos
Social media videos
AI avatars
Voice generation
Lip-syncing
Video localization
Social Media Automation

Build systems that can:
Generate content ideas
Create posts automatically
Generate captions
Produce short-form videos
Schedule posts
Publish across multiple platforms
Track analytics
Repurpose long-form content into reels, shorts, and clips
Platforms & Technologies

Experience with one or more of the following is highly preferred:
ElevenLabs
HeyGen
Open Source Fable
OpenAI APIs
Anthropic Claude
Google Gemini
LangChain
n8n
Make (Integromat)
Zapier
Cursor AI
GitHub Copilot
Python
Node.js
React
Next.js
Flutter
Docker
Kubernetes
PostgreSQL
Supabase
Firebase
REST APIs
GraphQL

If you have experience with additional AI tools or frameworks, we want to hear about them.

Proposal Requirements

Please include:
Your experience building AI-powered software and automation systems.
Examples of applications you've built.
Which AI tools you recommend and why.
How you would automate software development workflows.
How you would automate AI video production.
How you would automate social media creation and publishing.
Your recommended technology stack for long-term scalability.
Ideas for reducing development time and operational costs.
Any additional AI platforms or open-source tools you believe we should consider.
Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone who:
Thinks like a solutions architect
Has strong software engineering experience
Understands AI workflows end-to-end
Is proactive with recommendations
Can design scalable systems
Communicates clearly
Is interested in a long-term working relationship

If you're passionate about AI automation and enjoy building systems that eliminate manual work while increasing productivity, we'd love to hear your proposal.

siblingJobs.title: AI Social Media Growth & Automation Specialist (Content Creator, Video Editor & AI Systems)
siblingJobs.description: Job Title: AI Social Media Growth & Automation Specialist (Content Creator, Video Editor & AI Systems) About Apex Cloud Development Apex Cloud Development is an AI, software, automation, and digital growth company helping businesses grow through cutting-edge technology. We are building an AI-first marketing department and are looking for an experienced **Social Media Growth & Automation Specialist** who can create high-performing content while building automated systems that scale our online presence across every major platform. This is not just a social media manager position. We're looking for someone who can combine **creative content, AI, automation, growth strategies, and technical systems** to help us build multiple large social media brands. Position Overview We are looking for someone who can build a complete AI-powered social media ecosystem that: * Creates content * Edits videos * Designs graphics * Produces viral short-form videos * Grows followers organically * Automates repetitive tasks * Builds AI workflows * Generates leads from social media * Creates personal and business brands Our goal is to automate as much of the social media process as possible while maintaining high-quality, engaging content. Primary Responsibilities Content Creation Create engaging content for: * Instagram * Facebook * TikTok * YouTube * YouTube Shorts * LinkedIn * X (Twitter) * Threads * Pinterest * Snapchat * Reddit (where appropriate) Content includes: * Reels * Shorts * Long-form videos * Carousels * Infographics * Stories * Animated graphics * Promotional videos * Educational videos * Product showcases * AI-generated visuals Video Editing Produce professional videos including: * Motion graphics * Captions * Sound effects * Trending music * Color grading * Transitions * AI voiceovers * AI avatars * Green screen effects * Thumbnail creation * Hook optimization * Call-to-actions Graphic Design Design: * Social media posts * Carousels * Advertisements * Banners * Logos * Infographics * Brand assets * Website graphics * Marketing materials Experience with: * Canva * Adobe Photoshop * Illustrator * Figma * Midjourney * ChatGPT Image Generation * Adobe Express * CapCut * Other AI design tools AI Video Creation Experience with: * Runway * Veo * Kling * Pika * Luma * Synthesia * HeyGen * ElevenLabs * CapCut AI * Adobe Firefly * Other AI video platforms Social Media Growth Develop and execute strategies to: * Grow followers organically * Increase engagement * Improve watch time * Increase shares * Increase saves * Improve click-through rates * Build communities * Generate inbound leads * Drive website traffic * Increase conversions Social Media Automation Build automated workflows for: * Scheduling content * Cross-posting to multiple platforms * Content repurposing * AI-generated captions * AI hashtag generation * Comment monitoring * Social listening * Analytics reporting * Performance tracking * Approval workflows Experience with: * Buffer * Hootsuite * Metric

siblingJobs.title: Government Contracts & Proposal Specialist (Web, Software & App Development)
siblingJobs.description: Job Title: Government Contracts & Proposal Specialist (Web, Software & App Development) About Apex Cloud Development Apex Cloud Development is a rapidly growing technology company specializing in custom websites, enterprise software, mobile applications, AI automation, cloud solutions, and digital transformation. We are expanding into the government sector and are looking for an experienced **Government Contracts & Proposal Specialist** to help us identify, pursue, and win government contracts at the federal, state, county, and municipal levels. This is not simply a proposal writing role—we are looking for someone who understands the government procurement process from beginning to end and can build a repeatable system that consistently generates qualified contract opportunities. Position Overview We are seeking a highly experienced Government Contracts Specialist who has successfully won government contracts for technology services including: * Website Development * Website Redesign * Custom Software Development * Mobile App Development * AI Solutions * Cloud Infrastructure * Cybersecurity * IT Consulting * Digital Transformation * System Modernization * Managed IT Services Your mission will be to build a repeatable pipeline of government opportunities and help Apex Cloud Development become a recognized government technology contractor. Primary Responsibilities Government Opportunity Research Identify contract opportunities across: * SAM.gov * State procurement portals * County procurement websites * City purchasing departments * School districts * Universities * Healthcare organizations * Federal agencies * Department of Defense (where applicable) * Cooperative purchasing networks * Government technology procurement sites Proposal Management * Review RFPs * Review RFQs * Review RFIs * Review Sources Sought notices * Determine bid viability * Build proposal timelines * Coordinate required documentation * Submit complete proposals before deadlines Proposal Writing Develop winning proposals including: * Executive summaries * Technical responses * Company qualifications * Past performance * Staffing plans * Project methodology * Risk mitigation * Quality assurance * Pricing support * Compliance matrices Government Registration & Compliance Assist Apex Cloud with: * SAM.gov registration * UEI management * NAICS code recommendations * PSC code recommendations * SBA certifications * Minority certifications (if applicable) * Small Business certifications * HUBZone guidance (if applicable) * State vendor registrations Pipeline Development Create a repeatable process that: * Finds new contracts daily * Filters contracts matching our services * Scores opportunities * Tracks deadlines * Organizes proposal tasks * Tracks win/loss ratios * Creates forecasting reports AI & Automation Experience (Preferred) We are particularly interested in candidates who can automate the government bidding process using AI. * AI contract opportunity monitoring * AI proposal d

siblingJobs.title: Contract Full-Stack Developer – AWS Server Migration
siblingJobs.description: About the Role We're looking for an experienced contract Full-Stack Developer to support and execute a server migration of our existing web application from AWS to a new hosting environment. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across the full stack and has hands-on experience with production migrations. Tech Stack • Frontend: React • Backend: Django (Python) • Database: PostgreSQL What You'll Do • Audit the current AWS infrastructure and document the existing architecture • Plan and execute the migration of the React frontend, Django backend, and PostgreSQL database to the new server environment • Update environment configurations, secrets, and deployment pipelines as needed • Ensure zero or minimal downtime during the cutover • Perform post-migration testing to verify functionality, performance, and data integrity • Troubleshoot any issues that arise during or after the migration What We're Looking For • Proven experience with React and Django in production environments • Solid understanding of PostgreSQL database management and migration • Familiarity with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, etc.) • Experience migrating or deploying applications to non-AWS environments (VPS, bare metal, GCP, Azure, etc.) • Strong knowledge of environment setup: Nginx, Gunicorn, Docker, or similar • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly on progress and blockers Nice to Have • Experience with CI/CD pipeline setup • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Ansible)
